info.name: NISPL Cloud Tech - Structured API Collection
info.description:
Structured Postman API Collection for Net Infotech System (NISPL) Enterprise Platform.
Organized into dedicated personas: Admin Portal, Customer Portal, and System & Health services.
All endpoints are verified against active frontend services and backend routes. Automated sync enabled.

variable.description: Base API Server URL (http://localhost:4000 or production https://website-ebxf.onrender.com)
JWT Bearer Access Token (automatically populated after Admin or Customer login)
Authenticated customer email used for scoping customer queries
Client session identifier for Cart operations
Active customer record identifier or Mongo ID
Active contract agreement identifier or Mongo ID
Payment / invoice identifier or Mongo ID

item.name: Admin
item.description: All backend APIs supporting the NISPL Admin Portal, Staff Backoffice, and Operations Management.

item.name: 1. Authentication & Onboarding
item.description: Admin initial onboarding, OTP verification, login, profile inspection, and session management.

request.description: Checks whether a primary administrator has already been provisioned and returns the configured admin email.
Dispatches a 6-digit one-time verification password to the configured administrator inbox.
Verifies admin OTP and registers the primary administrator.
Authenticates an administrator with portal claim verification and returns a signed JWT.
Returns the authenticated administrator's role, permissions, and session profile.
Changes the authenticated user password and invalidates active session tokens.
Refreshes the current access token.
Clears session cookies and revokes refresh tokens.

item.name: 2. Portal & Dashboard
item.description: Customer portal summary telemetry, remote desktop connectivity credentials, search, demo activation, and direct payment.

request.description: Returns client overview telemetry: active cloud nodes, demo trial usage flags (demoTrialUsed, demoExtensionAllowed), and billing status.
Retrieves customer's cloud server connection specs, static IP address, RDP port, and license details.
Activates a complimentary demo plan. Enforces single-use trial policy unless explicitly authorized for extension by an admin.
Provides unified instant search across customer products, subscriptions, and receipts.
Allows customer to submit payment against outstanding dues directly from the customer portal.

item.name: 3. Cart & Commerce
item.description: Customer session cart, item configuration, add-ons, quantity modifications, and checkout fulfillment.

item.name: Get Session Cart with Tax & Totals

request.description: Retrieves the active customer cart including subtotal, GST calculation, discounts, and line items.

Modifies item quantity in the cart with dynamic subtotal recalculation.
Removes a specific line item from the active cart.
Toggles provisioning fulfillment preference.
Clears all line items from the active session cart.

item.name: 4. Subscriptions & Contracts

request.description: Returns all active and historical contracts for the authenticated customer.

item.name: 5. Invoices & Receipts
item.description: Customer view of billing invoices, receipts, and Razorpay payment gateway checkout.

request.description: Returns invoices and payment receipts associated with the customer account.
Retrieves client-side publishable Razorpay Key ID, currency, and gateway operational status.
Opens a server-verified Razorpay order with server-calculated rupee pricing and customer prefill data.
Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature returned by Razorpay checkout modal before creating ledger payment record.

item.name: 6. Notifications
item.description: Customer portal alerts, renewal notifications, and provisioning updates.

request.description: Streams customer-scoped alerts, payment reminders, and trial expiration notices.
Marks a customer notification as read.

item.name: System & Health
item.description: Health checks, root service manifest, and runtime environment inspection.

request.description: Returns backend runtime status, environment info, and top-level endpoints summary.
Standard liveness check used by cloud orchestrators and monitoring probes.
Asynchronous webhook receiver invoked by Razorpay servers to ensure ledger settlement.
